validity.researcher_notes: The branch is real. The 2021 Gazprom release describes a branch of almost 40 km, and the sheet records 98 km for the whole route through Tyukalinsk, Valuevskaya and Nalimovskaya. No wiki citation shows completion.

verifications.note: Article of June 2023, read in full. Lists the Nazyvaevsk and Nalimovskaya stations.
Release of 9 September 2021 read as a Wayback copy by hand because the verifier could not reach archive.org. Names the Nazyvaevsk branch.

fills.researcher_notes: No wiki citation names the owner of this pipeline. The owner on the sheet stays as it is. Not searched this pass.

The wiki citations are plans. The 2021 Gazprom release says construction is in three stages with the third due at the end of 2022. The Neftegaz article was run through scripts/fetch.py with the curl, TLS impersonation and Chrome routes, and all three failed with a bot wall. No Wayback capture exists. No citation shows the line in service.
The wiki citations are plans. The 2021 Gazprom release puts the end of the third stage at the end of 2022. That is a plan and does not show the actual start.

Item 227 of the federal decree lists the Nazyvaevsk gas pipeline branch and gas distribution station, through Nalimovskoe and Valuevskoe, with a planned annual volume of 41.2 million cubic meters. That rounds to 0.04 billion. One source agrees within rounding, so the sheet value stays.

verifications.note: Federal decree 816-r as amended through 17 December 2025, read in full. Item 227 gives 41.2 million cubic meters a year, which is 0.04 billion when rounded. Name found as Nazyvaevsk with Nalimovskoe and Valuevskoe.
